name: wpf-net472-airgap-dev-pack
description: Offline / air-gapped WPF development toolkit for Claude Code, specialized for existing .NET Framework 4.7.2-4.8 (net472/net48) WPF solutions. Local-only MCP knowledge server (no online MCP dependencies), legacy project detection/preservation (non-SDK csproj, packages.config, app.config), and dependency-free MVVM (hand-rolled BindableBase/RelayCommand with DevExpress.Mvvm detection; no CommunityToolkit.Mvvm). Fork of wpf-dev-pack by vincent lee (christian289).
